description_en: Queries the picture information captured by an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询IPC设备获取的图片信息
name: QueryDevicePictureFile

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page of the IoT Platform console or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to view the information of all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the picture generated when a capture event occurs:
For pictures captured by active triggering, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107914.html for the picture ID.
For pictures captured by intelligent alert events, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107916.html for the picture ID
parameters.help_zh:
抓图事件发生时，生成的图片ID：
主动触发抓图时，图片ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107914.html。
智能告警事件触发抓图时，图片ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107916.html
parameters.name: capture_id

parameters.help_en: The width of the target thumbnail, in pixels. Valid values: 1 to 4096
parameters.help_zh: 指定目标缩放图的宽度，单位为px，取值范围为1~4096
parameters.name: thumb_width

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of the picture URL, in minutes. Valid values: 1 to 43200
parameters.help_zh: 图片URL的失效时间，单位为分钟，取值范围为1~43200
parameters.name: expire_time

parameters.help_en:
The picture type. Valid values:

0: thumbnail.
1: original picture. 
2 (default): all
parameters.help_zh:
图片类型：

0：缩略图
1：原图 
2（默认）：全部
parameters.name: picture_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Instance Overview page or </ph></props>no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

IotId.description_en: The device ID of the IPC device

PicCreateTime.description_en: The time when the picture was created. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
PicCreateTime.description_zh: 图片创建时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
